_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Oli omuzannyi {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe ya bazannyi batatu.
Ekitebezo kyo kye '{symbol}'.
Ozina okukola kuza kuwanga ekitebezo kyo ku bodi ya 5x5 okuzza ekifo ekimu.
Ekifo kino kizza kuva ku mulyango, waggulu, oba ku kisulo.
Tuma kuza kwo usinga mu ngeri '[4]' okwawula kifo cha 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Enkola y'okutambula si nnungi. Kozesa "[cell]" nga cell 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ennamba ya kasirise etakkirizibwa: {cell}. Erina okubeera wakati wa 0 ne {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Omuzannyi {player_id} azza amakubiro ge ({symbol}) mu kifo ({row}, {col}).
